data.one_liner: Flutter widgets that render iOS‑style liquid‑glass blur surfaces and navigation bars.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable glass‑like container using BackdropFilter and a set of Cupertino‑styled navigation bars with spring physics. Adapts automatically to light/dark CupertinoTheme and offers fine‑grained visual controls.
use_when: You want an iOS‑like frosted‑glass UI without native code
You need ready‑made glass navigation bars with physics and accessibility support
You target multiple platforms (iOS, Android, web, desktop)
avoid_when: Exact pixel‑perfect replication of native iOS blur is required
Performance on low‑end devices is a primary concern
Your app runs on Flutter versions older than 3.32.0
strengths: Real BackdropFilter blur with customizable layers
Accessible semantics out of the box
weaknesses: Pure visual approximation, not a native UIKit bridge
Potential performance cost on large blur areas
